title: David Anointed King of Judah

questions.question: Where was David anointed king over the house of Judah?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:1-4 (ESV): "...And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah."

questions.question: Who was made king over Israel by Abner?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:8-9 (ESV): "But Abner... took Ish-bosheth the son of Saul... and he made him king..."

questions.question: Who was the commander of Saul's army?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:8 (ESV): "But Abner the son of Ner, commander of Saul's army..."

questions.question: Who was the commander of David's army (implied/active)?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:13 (ESV): "And Joab the son of Zeruiah and the servants of David went out..."

questions.question: What city did David bless for burying Saul?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:5 (ESV): "David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh-gilead and said to them, 'May you be blessed by the LORD... because you showed this loyalty to Saul your lord and buried him.'"

questions.question: How many young men from each side fought at the pool of Gibeon?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:15 (ESV): "Then they arose and passed over by number, twelve for Benjamin... and twelve of the servants of David."

questions.question: Which of Joab's brothers was killed by Abner?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:23 (ESV): "But he refused to turn aside. Therefore Abner struck him in the stomach... and he died there."

questions.question: What was Asahel known for?
options: Being as swift of foot as a wild gazelle
questions.correctAnswer: Being as swift of foot as a wild gazelle
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:18 (ESV): "...And Asahel was as swift of foot as a wild gazelle."

questions.question: What did they call the place where the young men fought and died?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:16 (ESV): "...Therefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which is at Gibeon."

questions.question: How long did David reign in Hebron?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:11 (ESV): "And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months."

questions.question: Where did the battle stop at sunset?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:24 (ESV): "...and the sun went down when they came to the hill of Ammah..."

questions.question: How did Abner kill Asahel?
options: With the butt of his spear
questions.correctAnswer: With the butt of his spear
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:23 (ESV): "...Therefore Abner struck him in the stomach with the butt of his spear, so that the spear came out at his back."

questions.question: How many of David's servants were missing after the battle vs 360 of Abner's?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:30-31 (ESV): "...nineteen men of David's servants were missing, and Asahel. But the servants of David had struck down... 360 men (of Benjamin)."

questions.question: Abner called out to Joab, "Shall the sword devour ______?"
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:26 (ESV): "Then Abner called to Joab, 'Shall the sword devour forever? Do you not know that the end will be bitter?'"

questions.question: How old was Ish-bosheth when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Samuel 2:10 (ESV): "Ish-bosheth, Saul's son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel..."

key_verse_text: And the men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. (ESV)
